# Business Cycle Deep Dive Analysis

Report 063 | Published 2021-07-25 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-7-25/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/063.json)

Cycle signals, digital assets, and Chinese equities.

Modest H2 yield direction and continued inflation were supported. The dated China rebound expectation failed; its well-articulated risk list did not prevent an optimistic timing conclusion. Several technical and valuation observations lack a falsifiable investment rule. Gold and Bitcoin sensitivities are positive but do not authenticate their causal models.

**Coverage:** Read all blocks 0-215 and 35 image labels. Includes macro mechanisms, conditional technical theses, Chinese regulatory risks and defensive holdings. Routine holdings without thesis and incidental statistics excluded.

## Analytical tools and charts

- **Cycle dashboard:** Growth; spreads; ratios. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Valuation:** Real yields; cash flow. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Network indicators:** Capacity; supply; breakouts. Visual inspection: not performed.
- **Breadth:** Participation; drawdowns. Visual inspection: not performed.

## Framework lessons

- Separate policy plumbing from valuation.

## Verification limitations

- Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
- Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
- No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
